conditions.displayName: transit-db-export execution finished FAILED or CANCELLED

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/Workflow" AND resource.labels.workflow_id = "transit-db-export" AND metric.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/finished_execution_count" AND metric.labels.status != "SUCCEEDED"

documentation.content:
The weekly Cloud SQL export did not finish, or the file was under 500 MB.

1. See why:
   `gcloud workflows executions list transit-db-export --location asia-northeast3 --project seoul-transit-prod --limit 1 --format="value(state,error.payload)"`
2. Check whether another operation held the instance:
   `gcloud sql operations list --instance transit-db --project seoul-transit-prod --limit 5`
3. Run it again once the instance is free:
   `gcloud workflows execute transit-db-export --location asia-northeast3 --project seoul-transit-prod`
